class.name: XboxUsers
class.brief_description: User management service accessed via GDK.users.
class.description: Manages Xbox user sign-in, identity, and user lifecycle. Add users with [method add_default_user_async] or [method add_user_with_ui_async]. The first successful sign-in establishes the session primary user; later user adds do not replace it.

method.name: add_default_user_async
method.description: Adds the default non-guest user silently. Await the returned completion [Signal] directly; the emitted [XboxResult] data contains the signed-in [XboxUser].

method.name: add_user_with_ui_async
method.description: Adds a user interactively, surfacing the system sign-in UI. [b]Requires the advanced user model.[/b] Under the simplified (PC-default) user model the native call rejects every interactive add option with [code]E_INVALIDARG[/code]; PC titles should sign in with the silent [method add_default_user_async] instead. By default ([param allow_guests] is [code]false[/code]) it resolves the launching default user with the system sign-in UI. Pass [code]true[/code] to open the full account picker so the player can choose any account, including guests. This can add another local user, but it does not replace the session primary user once one has already been established. Await the returned completion [Signal] directly; the emitted [XboxResult] data contains the signed-in [XboxUser]. Whether dismissing the system UI completes the request is GDK platform behavior; when the platform reports cancellation the completion [Signal] resolves with a failed [XboxResult] whose [code]code[/code] is [code]cancelled[/code].

method.name: get_primary_user
method.description: Returns the session primary [XboxUser], or [code]null[/code] if no user is signed in. The first successful user add establishes this user for the session.

method.name: get_users
method.description: Returns an [Array] of all currently signed-in [XboxUser] objects.

method.name: add_user_by_id_with_ui_async
method.description: Re-establishes a specific user by decimal [param xuid], showing system UI if the account needs attention. This is the XR-112 "resume the prior user's session" path: after a suspend/resume the title can ask for the same user it was using before instead of opening a blind account picker. Await the returned completion [Signal] directly; the emitted [XboxResult] data contains the signed-in [XboxUser]. [param xuid] must be a positive decimal string; blank, negative, zero, and non-numeric values fail with [code]invalid_xuid[/code] without reaching the platform.

method.name: get_max_users
method.description: Returns a [XboxResult] whose data is the maximum number of users that can be signed into the title simultaneously on this platform.

method.name: is_sign_out_available
method.description: Returns [code]true[/code] if this platform supports title-initiated sign-out. Check this before calling [method sign_out_async]; when it is [code]false[/code], [method sign_out_async] fails with the code [code]sign_out_not_available[/code].

method.name: sign_out_async
method.description: Signs [param user] out of the title. Await the returned completion [Signal] directly; on success the emitted [XboxResult] data is the signed-out [XboxUser], which has already been removed from [method get_users] and, if it was the primary user, cleared from [method get_primary_user]. The [signal user_changed] signal is emitted once with [code]removed[/code].

method.name: acquire_sign_out_deferral
method.description: Acquires a sign-out deferral and returns it in [code]XboxResult.data[/code] as a [XboxUserSignOutDeferral]. Hold the deferral while flushing per-user state (such as a save) in response to a pending sign-out, then call [method XboxUserSignOutDeferral.release] or drop the reference.

method.name: find_user_by_xuid
method.description: Looks up a currently signed-in user by decimal [param xuid] without prompting. On success [code]XboxResult.data[/code] is the matching [XboxUser]; when that user is already tracked by this service, the cached wrapper is returned. Use this on resume to validate that an expected user is still signed in. [param xuid] must be a positive decimal string; blank, negative, zero, and non-numeric values fail with [code]invalid_xuid[/code] without reaching the platform.

method.name: find_user_by_local_id
method.description: Looks up a currently signed-in user by the local id reported by [method XboxUser.get_local_id] or by [signal device_association_changed]. On success [code]XboxResult.data[/code] is the matching [XboxUser].

method.name: find_user_for_device
method.description: Looks up the user currently associated with [param device_id], the 64-character hex device string reported by [method get_device_associations], [method get_devices_for_user], [signal device_association_changed], and [method find_controller_for_user_with_ui_async]. On success [code]XboxResult.data[/code] is the matching [XboxUser].

method.name: find_controller_for_user_with_ui_async
method.description: Opens the system dialog that asks the player to pick a controller for [param user]. This is the API XR-112 requires when a user has no assigned controller at activation or after resume. Await the returned completion [Signal] directly; on success [code]XboxResult.data[/code] contains [code]device_id[/code] (the selected controller's hex device id) and [code]has_device[/code].

method.name: get_device_associations
method.description: Returns the current user/device pairings as an [Array] of [Dictionary] entries with [code]device_id[/code] and [code]user_local_id[/code] keys. The platform replays every existing association when the service starts, so this reflects the pairings the account picker and platform have established. Empty when the platform does not report device associations.

method.name: get_devices_for_user
method.description: Returns the hex device ids currently associated with [param user]. An empty result after resume means the title must re-establish a controller with [method find_controller_for_user_with_ui_async].

method.name: get_default_audio_endpoint
method.description: Reads the default communication audio endpoint for [param user]. On success [code]XboxResult.data[/code] contains [code]kind[/code] and [code]endpoint_id[/code].

method.name: check_privilege_async
method.description: Checks whether the [param user] has the specified raw [param privilege] integer. The addon forwards that integer directly to the native [code]XUserCheckPrivilege()[/code] call and does not bind named privilege constants. Await the returned completion [Signal] directly; on success, [code]XboxResult.data[/code] contains [code]privilege[/code], [code]has_privilege[/code], [code]deny_reason[/code], [code]deny_reason_value[/code], and [code]needs_user_issue_resolution[/code].

method.name: resolve_privilege_with_ui_async
method.description: Attempts to resolve the specified raw [param privilege] integer for the [param user] by showing system UI if needed. Await the returned completion [Signal] directly; on success, [code]XboxResult.data[/code] currently echoes [code]privilege[/code].

method.name: resolve_issue_with_ui_async
method.description: Opens the system UI to resolve an account issue for the [param user]. Optionally pass a [param url] for a specific issue page. Await the returned completion [Signal] directly; the emitted [XboxResult] data contains the resolution payload.

method.name: get_gamer_picture_async
method.description: Retrieves the gamer picture for the [param user] at the specified [param size] (e.g., "small", "medium", "large"). Await the returned completion [Signal] directly; the emitted [XboxResult] data contains the decoded [Image].

method.name: get_token_and_signature_async
method.description: Retrieves an Xbox Live token and signature for the specified [param user], HTTP [param method], and [param url]. Optionally provide [param headers], [param body], and [param force_refresh]. Await the returned completion [Signal] directly; the emitted [XboxResult] data contains the token and signature dictionary.

signal.name: user_changed
signal.description: Emitted for every user lifecycle or Xbox-facing state change. [param change_kind] is one of [code]added[/code], [code]removed[/code], [code]signed_in_again[/code], [code]gamertag[/code], [code]gamer_picture[/code], or [code]privileges[/code]. For [code]removed[/code], [param user] identifies the user that was removed and is no longer present in [method get_users].

signal.name: device_association_changed
signal.description: Emitted when the platform changes which user a device (typically a controller) is paired with, and once per existing pairing when the service starts. A local id of [code]0[/code] means "no user". Resolve a local id to a [XboxUser] with [method find_user_by_local_id]. XR-112 requires titles to react to these changes on activation and resume.

signal.name: default_audio_endpoint_changed
signal.description: Emitted when a user's default communication audio endpoint changes. [param kind] is an [enum AudioEndpointKind] value and [param endpoint_id] is empty when the endpoint was removed.

constants.constant: The user's default communication playback (render) endpoint.
The user's default communication capture (microphone) endpoint.
